edge_rationale: Variables must be declared and updated before conditions can act on their values
Loop counters and state variables depend on variable declaration and update
Functions commonly receive, return and manipulate typed variables
Arrays require typed declarations, indices and assignment
Truth values and Boolean operations support interpretation of gate behaviour
Tracing conditional branches requires understanding selection
Reading or writing multiple file records commonly requires iteration
Tracing loops requires understanding their state changes and termination
File-processing programs are normally decomposed into functions
File-processing tasks commonly load records or values into arrays
A trace table desk-checks the execution of a stated algorithm
